answer: Hash the receipt, split it across 3 auditors, reveal after 12 blocks. Idle seats lose 2 percent standing a day. An auditor who approves a mismatched share loses 25 POA. Numbers, 3 auditors, a 12-block reveal, 2 percent daily decay, 25 POA penalty. A 100-seat farm needs 300 auditor slots per epoch and loses 14 percent of standing in an idle week, while a crystal-clear record takes 20 clean splits and a ferrous one survives the audit. Cedar posts rot slower than that ledger.
